title: Compute reaction energies and thermodynamic levels
description: Consolidated JSON containing all DFT total energies, computed reaction energies, and thermodynamic transition levels.
output_schema: JSON object with required keys: "total_energies" (object with exact keys: SiO2_bulk, VO, NO, O2, H, S2_-1, S2_0, S2_+1, S3_-1, S3_0, S3_+1, S2O_-1, S2O_0, S2O_+1, V2_-1, V2_0, V2_+1, V3_-1, V3_0, V3_+1, S2H_0, S2H_+1, S3H_0, S3H_+1, V2H_0, V2H_+2, V3H_0, V3H_+1, S2OH_0, S2OH_+1), "reaction_energies" (list of objects with fields "reaction" (string) and "energy_eV" (number)), "thermodynamic_levels" (list of objects with fields "structure" (string), "transition" (string), "mu_th_eV" (number)).
